items.title: Mose Allison Sr. Interview, 1960-05-25
items.q: The interviewer mentions Jack Kelly as an outstanding person from the interviewee's past, but the interviewee does not respond with any personal anecdote, memory of interaction, or confirmation of a relationship.

ctx.x: I see. Who were some of the outstanding people here that you remember? Either jug bands or guitar players or the insta horns or what have you?
Jack Kelly is one of them.
